title: Project Rebuild
author: James Jordan
desc: Project Rebuild is a 6-week reconnection program designed for women rebuilding core function after pregnancy. Before the weights, before the cardio, before any of it — there is the foundation. Rebuilt restores the deep core muscles that pregnancy stretched and silenced, closing the gap diastasis recti left behind and rebuilding the internal strength your body needs to do everything else safely and effectively. This is not a warmup. This is the work that makes all future work possible.
